english.note: Use 安靜 as the all-purpose choice for a quiet place or surroundings, and also for a calm, undisturbed state.
Use this for a place, person, or situation that is quiet and has little or no sound, rather than for inner emotional calm.
Use this instead of 平靜 when the emphasis is on a quiet, undisturbed place or environment.
Use this when a place or situation is quiet and free from noise or disturbance.
